name: Avana Plastic Surgery
address: 1645 SW 107th Ave Suite 114 C, Miami, FL 33165

brazilian-butt-lift.text: BBL cost in Miami at Avana Plastic Surgery starts at an affordable $3800
brazilian-butt-lift.conditions: Final price depends on amount of liposuction and fat transfer, technique and combined procedures; page tells readers to check weekly specials.

tummy-tuck.conditions: Figure appears only in the page title; body text gives a general Miami range of $3,500 to $10,000 rather than a stated Avana price. See notes for conflicting figures.

mommy-makeover.includes: 'Classic Makeover' package: tummy tuck plus a choice of breast lift, reduction or augmentation.
mommy-makeover.conditions: Other packages on the page start at $5,700 (BBL + Lipo 360/etching + breast augmentation), $6,200 (BBL + abdominoplasty) and $7,300 (BBL + breast lift).

lipo-360.text: the cost of lipo 360 starts at $3,000
lipo-360.conditions: Depends on patient size, number of areas and whether fat is transferred; exact quote at consultation.

arm-lift.conditions: Figure appears only in the page title; body text gives only a RealSelf market range ($4,500-$12,000), not an Avana price.

abdominal-etching.text: Abdominal Etching Miami - $4500 Ab sculpting surgery
abdominal-etching.conditions: Figure appears only in the page title; body text cites a Miami-area average of $6,000 including anesthesia, operating fees and garment, not described as Avana's price.

breast-augmentation.text: breast augmentation cost in Miami starts at $3,000
breast-augmentation.conditions: Final price depends on implant type, surgeon experience and facility fees.

breast-lift.text: breast lift prices range between $3,500 to $5,000
breast-lift.conditions: Same page's title says 'Starts at $3800', which conflicts with the $3,500 lower bound in the body text.

breast-reduction.conditions: Figure appears only in the page title; body text gives a general Miami average range of $3,500 to $7,000.

facelift.conditions: Deep plane facelift only, promoted on the home page as an introductory special tied to one surgeon (Dr. Triana); no end date seen. The general facelift page states no Avana price.

eyelid-surgery.text: Eyelid surgery Miami at Avana will cost $4,650 on average.
eyelid-surgery.conditions: An average, not a quote; varies with office location, anesthesia type and upper vs lower lids.

otoplasty.text: typical otoplasty Miami cost for ear surgery is $2,500-$4,700
otoplasty.conditions: Worded as a typical Miami cost (average $3,550) with no source cited; unclear whether it is Avana's own fee. Fee varies per patient.

botox-fillers.text: A Botox injection costs $20 per unit at Avana Plastic Surgery.
botox-fillers.conditions: Botox only, per unit; number of units varies by area (page gives examples of roughly $400-$480 per area). Filler prices were not checked.

financing: Site promotes financing through Alphaeon Credit with weekly payments (for example 'Liposuction from $25/Week With Financing'), subject to credit approval.
notes: Identity is clear; the site lists three South Florida offices (West Miami main office 1645 SW 107th Ave Suite 114 C; 8700 W Flagler St Suite 250, Miami, FL 33174; 7802 NW 103 St Suite 106, Hialeah Gardens, FL 33016) plus Dallas, TX. CONFLICTING PRICES: the home page shows 'Average Cost' figures that differ from the procedure pages (BBL $3800, Liposuction $3499, Tummy Tuck $4000, Breast Augmentation $2799, Mommy Makeover $6500), and the /specials page shows 'Special Price*' figures with no footnote or end date (Tummy Tuck plus full back lipo $6,000; Lipo 360 $2,800; Mommy Makeover $6,075; Breast Augmentation silicone implant $3,700; BBL plus lipo 12 areas plus J-Plasma $4,200). Per the brief, the procedure-page figure is recorded. Tummy tuck is the weakest entry: $3,500 (title), $4,000 (home page average) and $6,000 (special with back lipo) all appear. Several entries marked medium come only from the page <title>, with body text citing market averages. No Avana price was found on the thigh-lift, gynecomastia, rhinoplasty, general facelift or buccal fat pages (only ASPS/RealSelf averages, not recorded); neck-lift, laser-resurfacing and microneedling were not found in the navigation. GOOGLE: no Google rating shown; the /reviews page shows '4.5 out of 5 / 6021 client reviews or surveys' from internal surveys and the home page claims '+3200 5 star reviews' without naming a platform - neither recorded. Pages were read through an automated page summarizer, so exact quotes should be spot-checked before publication.
